Notes: The Secretary (PD04), The Collector instance 7015. Lines are the live capture dialogs_20261109_Cattywompus (pande-collector-20261109). Gravity Shift lines omitted (no server support yet). Arena teleport point (100,0,100) is derived from captured Flame/Frost Shade arena floor positions, not a captured teleport destination.

hello.Text: A young woman stares down at an old-fashioned data device, humming quietly to herself. As you draw near she peeks upward, smiling brightly. Hello! You're here to see the boss, right? He's been expecting you.

rules.Text: Ok then, let's see here... basic rules are that it's a challenge to the 'death' - If you manage to take down my boss, you're free to take a bit of his collection. Bring him down, you win! Die and... well, better luck next time, eh? Now then - When you're ready just say the word and I'll teleport you into the arena. The Collector's already there and waiting.

go.Text: Alright, I've told the boss and he's expecting your arrival. Good luck, and have fun!{teleport 7015 100.0 0.0 100.0}{close}
